content.title: What Erica Stoll does for a living: Inside Rory McIlroy's wife's career
content.text: What does Erica Stoll, Rory McIlroy's wife, do?Erica Stoll has built a respected career in the golf industry long before her relationship with Rory McIlroy. She graduated with a degree in Marketing from the Rochester Institute of Technology and went on to work for the PGA of America, where she held key roles including transport official, office manager, and volunteer operations manager at major championships.To watch this video, agree to share video information with third partiesAgree|More infoIt was her professionalism that ultimately connected her with McIlroy. The two met during the Ryder Cup in 2012, when she helped him arrive on time for his match after a scheduling mix-up - a moment that would later become part of their story.Is Rory McIlroy married?Yes. The couple married on April 22, 2017. After a proposal in Paris, they celebrated a fairytale wedding at Ashford Castle in Ireland.Despite rumors and a brief marital crisis in 2024, both decided to withdraw their divorce petition and recommit to their future as a family.Do they have children?Yes, they have one daughter, Poppy, born on August 31, 2020. Now 5 years old, she is often seen alongside her father at major tournaments, including the The Masters Tournament.Where does the family live?Although they own properties in Northern Ireland and near London (Wentworth), their primary residence is in Jupiter, Florida - a hub for many of the world's top professional golfers thanks to its elite facilities and favorable climate.Who are Rory's parents?McIlroy is the only child of Rosie and Gerry McIlroy, whose support was crucial to his rise. They worked multiple jobs during his childhood to fund his golf career. This year, they are present at Augusta National Golf Club, backing him in his pursuit of another major title.
